reference_sql:
WITH units AS (
  -- one row per Earbuds or Headphones product sold in 2025
  SELECT ol.product_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL THEN ol.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS promo_units,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ol.promo_id IS NULL THEN ol.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS full_price_units
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id IN (15, 16)
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY ol.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, promo_units, full_price_units,
  ROUND(100.0 * promo_units / (promo_units + full_price_units), 1) AS promo_share_pct
FROM units

  SELECT p.product_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity) FILTER (WHERE l.promo_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS promo_units,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity) FILTER (WHERE l.promo_id IS NULL), 0) AS full_price_units
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id IN (15, 16)
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY p.product_id
)
SELECT product_id, promo_units, full_price_units,
  ROUND(100.0 * promo_units / (promo_units + full_price_units), 1) AS promo_share_pct
